title: Traits
summary: Permanent bonuses bought with Trait Bubbles. Traits can be reset for a refund.

rows.sub: Increases the level of heroes and minions summoned in the stage.

rows: +1 Lv per level, up to +30 Lv

rows.sub: Uses an AoE skill that hits all enemies when summoning a hero in the stage.
Increases the basic level of Summon Bubbles, a currency used to summon and upgrade in stages. The maximum bubble limit will increase after the upgrade.

rows: +1 Lv per level, up to +5 Lv

rows.sub: Reduces cooldown time for summoning heroes and minions.
The hero uses an AoE skill that hits all enemies during every cooldown after being summoned in the stage.
Increases the charging speed of Summon Bubbles, a currency used to summon and upgrade in stages.
Reduces cost for summoning heroes and minions.
Increases the ATK of heroes in the stage.
